_readme: Gold set for retrieval precision@k/recall@k. Every query names its expected company/companies explicitly in the question itself — that's what makes 'expected_companies' an objective label rather than a judgment call (unlike a topic query such as 'which companies discussed cost cuts', whose true answer set can only be known by reading every report). 'expected_companies' values must match the filename prefix convention pipeline/ingest.py uses (company = filename.split('_')[0]) — see app/branding.py's COMPANIES list for the canonical key per constituent (e.g. VW, not Volkswagen; Mercedes, not MercedesBenz).
